request.style: English, hard rock, powerful raspy male vocal, distorted electric guitars, heavy bass, pounding drums, dramatic build, 126 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Set apart to God before he ever saw the light
No razor on his head and the Spirit gave him might
In the vineyards of Timnah a young lion roared and ran
And he tore the lion apart with his bare hands

[Verse]
Down in the Valley of Sorek Delilah held him near
The rulers of the Philistines put silver in her ear
Tell me, where does your great strength come from
Night after night she pressed him till he told her everything in his heart

[Pre-Chorus]
She lulled him to sleep on her lap
Seven braids fell to the floor
Samson, the Philistines are upon you
But he did not know that the LORD had left him

[Verse]
They took his eyes and chained him, grinding grain in Gaza's jail
But the hair of his head began to grow back
They brought him out to Dagon's house to laugh at what he'd lost
Three thousand on the rooftop, and he stood between the posts

[Chorus]
Sovereign LORD, remember me
Please, God, strengthen me just once more
Blind and bound in the house of Dagon
Hands upon the pillars, I am crying out to you

[Bridge]
He pushed with all his might
And the temple came down
He pushed with all his might
And the temple came down

[Chorus]
Sovereign LORD, remember me
Please, God, strengthen me just once more
Blind and bound in the house of Dagon
Hands upon the pillars, I am crying out to you

[Outro]
Sovereign LORD, remember me
